title: Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs: Testing, Certification and Complaint Response Standards by Tier
content:
## Standard by tier

The indoor air quality testing side of the company holds the following standard for the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs. It fixes, for each tier, the number of air quality test visits in a year, the parameters measured at a test visit, laboratory analysis and its charge, the report period, the annual certificate and its charge, the included tenant complaint investigations and the response commitments.

| Standard | Filter Supply Program | Managed Filtration Program | Coil Hygiene Program | Air Quality Monitoring Program | UV & Purification Service Program | Certified Indoor Air Quality Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Indoor air quality test visits included per year | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 4 |
| Laboratory analysis of collected samples included | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Laboratory fee per sample where analysis is not included (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Business days after a test or service visit by which the report is delivered | 0 | 10 | 10 | 7 | 7 | 5 |
| Annual indoor air quality certificate issued for the building | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Months a certificate stands before renewal (calendar months) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Fee to issue or renew the certificate where not included (USD) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1450 | 1250 | 0 |
| Tenant air quality complaint investigations included per year | 0 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 6 | 12 |
| Business days to attend a tenant air quality complaint | 10 | 7 | 5 | 3 | 3 | 1 |
| Guaranteed response to an air quality emergency such as a sewer gas or smoke complaint (elapsed hours) | 72 | 48 | 24 | 12 | 8 | 4 |

## Parameters measured at a test visit

| Parameter | Filter Supply Program | Managed Filtration Program | Coil Hygiene Program | Air Quality Monitoring Program | UV & Purification Service Program | Certified Indoor Air Quality Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Temperature and humidity | Not measured | Measured | Measured | Measured | Measured | Measured |
| Carbon dioxide | Not measured | Not measured | Measured | Measured | Measured | Measured |
| Fine particulate (PM2.5) | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | Measured | Measured | Measured |
| Volatile organic compounds | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | Measured | Measured | Measured |
| Carbon monoxide | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | Measured | Measured | Measured |
| Mould spores | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | Not measured | Measured | Measured |

## Points of reading

- The laboratory fee per sample is 0 USD at every tier of the schedule; laboratory analysis is included from the Air Quality Monitoring Program upward and not included at the three tiers below it.
- Only the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program issues the annual certificate, standing for 12 calendar months; the certificate fee is set at 1450 USD on the Air Quality Monitoring Program and 1250 USD on the UV & Purification Service Program, and 0 USD elsewhere.
- The Managed Filtration Program and the Coil Hygiene Program measure parameters at a test visit although they include 0 test visits a year; their parameter columns govern any test visit carried out under them.
- The response standard is stated in two units: complaint attendance in business days, emergency response in elapsed hours. At the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program a tenant complaint is attended within 1 business day and an emergency within 4 elapsed hours; at the Filter Supply Program the corresponding commitments are 10 business days and 72 elapsed hours.
